d:
Enjoy the evergreen romantic song “Loveria Hua” from the movie Raju Ban Gaya Gentleman. This beautiful 90s melody is sung by Kumar Sanu, Alka Yagnik and Jolly Mukherjee.
Song Credits:
Singer(s): Kumar Sanu, Alka Yagnik & Jolly Mukherjee
Music Director: Jatin-Lalit
Lyricist: Mahendra Dehlvi
Movie Credits:
Cast : Shahrukh Khan, Juhi Chawla, Amrita Singh, Nana Patekar
Director : Aziz Mirza
